messages:
leila: Quick flag from onboarding: new hires hit a confusing mismatch between our docs and the sampleapp creds. Some places use REDWOOD_KEY, others REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_ORG. New dev was stuck for 20m trying to figure out which to set in Codespaces.

matt: That's on us. Historically older samples used REDWOOD_KEY; we changed docs to REDWOOD_API_KEY months ago but never mass-updated sample repos.

sara: I chased the sampleapp and the CLI creds loader. CLI looks for REDWOOD_API_KEY, then FALLBACK_KEY, then ~/.config/redwood/credentials.json. But sampleapp README and .env.example still lists REDWOOD_KEY.

kumar: Suggestion: pick canonical env names: REDWOOD_API_KEY (primary), REDWOOD_PROJECT (optional project-scoped token), and REDWOOD_ORG (optional org-id). Define exact precedence: 1) explicit SDK init param, 2) env vars (REDWOOD_API_KEY first), 3) CLI creds file, 4) SDK profiles. Also add a runtime deprecation warning if legacy names are present.

leila: Nice. Action items: (A) update sampleapp .env.example and README to show canonical vars and migration note, (B) add a short note in onboarding checklist, (C) SDKs to emit single-tone warnings when legacy vars found. Can we keep the warning non-spammy? Maybe only once per process.

matt: Implementing non-spammy warnings in SDKs: keep a module-level boolean to ensure we only log once. For JS we can console.warn once; for Python use logging.warn with a guard. We'll also add a test for precedence.

jen: I'll PR the sampleapp edits. Proposed .env snippet I plan to include:

```
# .env.example
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...   # preferred dev key
REDWOOD_PROJECT=acme-app  # optional: scoped project id for dev workflows
# LEGACY: REDWOOD_KEY is deprecated and will be removed 2025-06-01
```

tim: I'll open sdk-interop issue and assign to SDK owners. We should also update the quickstart in docs to show checking env vars via `echo $REDWOOD_API_KEY` and CLI creds locations.

devex-bot: created issue #498 in repo sdk-interop: "Canonicalize credential env var names + document fallback order"  https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-interop/issues/498

leila: Thanks everyone. Target: land sampleapp + docs patch this week, SDK warnings and tests next sprint. Goal: cut onboarding time for new devs by removing this confusing divergence. :raised_hands:
